questions.stem_text:
What are the effects an increase in the money supply on output on prices in the short run
and in the long run?

options.A: Short run: increase in output, Long run: increase in general price level
options.B: Short run: decrease in output, Long run: no change in general price level
options.C: Short run: decrease in output, Long run: increase in general price level
options.D: Short run: increase in general price level, Long run: decrease in output
options.E: Short run: no change in output, Long run: increase in general price level

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Short run: increase in output, Long run: increase in general price level

questions.stem_text: Marginal cost always intersects average variable cost at

options.A: the minimum of average total cost
options.B: the point where average variable cost is equal to marginal cost
options.D: the maximum of average variable cost
options.E: the point of equilibrium between supply and demand

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the minimum of average total cost

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is an example of capital as an economic resource?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A barrel of crude oil

questions.stem_text: The price elasticity of demand for a product is greater if

options.A: the proportion of the good of the consumer's budget is high.
options.B: the number of substitute products is limited.
options.C: the product is unique and has no substitutes.
options.D: the consumer has a high income.
options.E: the period of time to respond to a price change is short.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the proportion of the good of the consumer's budget is high.

questions.stem_text: Investment demand most likely increases when

options.A: the stock market experiences a downturn.
options.C: the real rate of interest rises.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the stock market experiences a downturn.
